purpose: Teach: 引き取り/製法/未納/受け皿/賭ける/画策/押し付ける/強いる

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、引き取り、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're taking this case seriously and will pursue the investigation thoroughly. Thank you for your cooperation.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Steady cadence. Clear enunciation on key words. Professional warmth—confident without being distant. Even breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。違法薬物の、本気で、絶対、製法、絶対、警察、絶対、特定中、絶対、ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful the police are actively identifying the illegal drug production methods involved.
lines.style: Deferential but genuine. Slight lean-in on gratitude. Measured pace. Respectful without subservience—the tone of a cooperative witness, not a subordinate.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 罰金の、本気で、絶対、未納、絶対、件、絶対、警察、絶対、督促、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're also handling the unpaid fine case and moving forward with collection procedures. Thank you for understanding.
lines.style: Procedural and steady. Slight pause before listing each point—thorough, not rushed. Professional distance maintained. Warm undertone on the thanks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民相談の、本気で、絶対、受け皿、絶対、警察、絶対、整備、絶対、されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I understand the police have been establishing better resources for citizen inquiries. That's reassuring.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Slight emphasis on understanding the bigger picture. Calm, almost relieved—this is progress. Gentle trail-off at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、本気で、絶対、逃亡に、絶対、賭ける、絶対、ような、絶対、行動、絶対、警察、絶対、阻止しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The suspect's attempt to flee has been stopped. We ensured that situation didn't escalate further.
lines.style: Firm conviction on the action taken. Clear, direct delivery. Brief pause after 'stopped'—the finality of it. Professional confidence, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。組織犯罪の、本気で、絶対、画策、絶対、警察、絶対、解明、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We appreciate that the police are actively investigating the organized crime elements involved.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Measured, professional tone. Slight emphasis on 'actively'—affirming the thoroughness. Even pacing, no urgency.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、責任を、絶対、他者に、絶対、押し付ける、絶対、容疑者、絶対、警察、絶対、聴取、絶対、いたしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're currently interviewing the suspect regarding how responsibility was shifted onto others. Thank you for your diligence.
lines.style: Procedural and measured. Steady delivery on the details. Professional warmth at the close. Breath steady throughout—this is standard work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民に過剰負担を、本気で、絶対、強いる、絶対、ない、絶対、よう、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご配慮、絶対、お願いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We respectfully ask that the police consider the burden this places on citizens and address it carefully. Thank you.
lines.style: Polite but sincere request—not deferential, but respectful. Slight emphasis on 'carefully.' Warm closing. Measured throughout, like a formal but genuine appeal.
